title: The box label
logline: An archive box on a metal shelf. The label, typed: TIMBERLINE 1997–1999 · BACK PAGES. Below it, in pencil, someone has added: (finch). The parenthesis is the whole page.

panels.composition: A metal archive shelf, one gray box pulled a few inches out. Its typed label: TIMBERLINE 1997–1999 · BACK PAGES. Beneath the typing, in a librarian's pencil, small: (finch). The rest of the page is the shelf, the other boxes, the dust in the lamp light. The pencil word is the only thing the eye can rest on.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a gray archive box pulled slightly out from a metal library shelf, a typed label on its end and beneath it a small pencil annotation in parentheses, other boxes and dust in lamp light, nobody present, no words
image.notes: Letter after: TIMBERLINE 1997–1999 · BACK PAGES / (finch). The parenthesis in pencil, lowercase.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
